name: Kazali
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. [You choose which players are which Minions. -? to +? Outsiders]
designRole: Chooses Minions at setup and can change the Outsider count freely; requires nonstandard setup review.
explanation: Chooses Minions at setup and can change the Outsider count freely; requires nonstandard setup review.

nightInstructions.firstNight: The Kazali chooses which players are which Minions. Wake each target. Show the *YOU ARE* and Minion tokens & give a thumbs-down.

storytellerNotes: Selected Minions and arbitrary Outsider count change normal setup assumptions.

jinxes.reason: If the Kazali turns the Bounty Hunter into a Minion, an evil Townsfolk is not created.
If there would be a Marionette in play, they enter play after the Demon & must start as their neighbor.
If the Summoner creates a second living Demon, deaths tonight are arbitrary.
